violations.detail: n:aa9n0 deleted on A at step 170 is back in canvas/c3.canvas with no concurrent edit and no conflict copy

note: Nightly sweep, seed 327686334. C's store was wiped before its synced mirror recorded the canvas sync that brought node aa9n0; A deleted the node meanwhile. On recovery C had no stored base and an empty CRDT, and the merge took the empty canvas as the base, so the stale disk copy re-added the node everywhere. Fix: canvasJob does not take a base from the CRDT side (empty, or at the synced hash) when the disk holds a record the CRDT deleted (canvasDoc diskHoldsDeletedRecord); a no-base conflict copy keeps the disk text. Focused tests: reconciler.canvas.test.ts "a store lost before its sync point ..." and "a stale synced mirror ...". canvas-stale-mirror-revives-deleted-node.json is the same seed's full-run plan (the stale mirror entry at the CRDT's hash).
